name: xflickr_work_backlog_stale

query_condition.sql: SELECT max(CASE WHEN metric='work_items_oldest_age_seconds' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS oldest_seconds, max(CASE WHEN metric='work_items_pending' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS pending FROM "xflickr_metrics" WHERE metric IN ('work_items_oldest_age_seconds','work_items_pending') HAVING oldest_seconds > 21600 AND pending > 0

description: Impact: Pending work is older than 6 hours. Action: Check scheduler progress, key/quota availability, and worker throughput.
